serverInfo.name: Arbitron
serverInfo.description: Funding rates, cross-venue spreads and listings for crypto perpetual futures, the signed-in trader's own cards, trades, PnL and balances, and the Arbitron knowledge base. Read-only.

tools.name: arbitron_search_coins
tools.title: Search coins
tools.description: Finds coins by ticker (the start of it, or any part with match=contains) and returns, per coin, the venues quoting a perpetual on it, its 24h perpetual volume in USDT and the page that shows its funding. Filter by venue, venue count or volume. Use it to resolve a name to the ticker the other tools take.

tools.name: arbitron_get_funding_rates
tools.title: Funding rates across venues
tools.description: Current funding rate of perpetual contracts on every venue Arbitron tracks, one row per venue and symbol, sorted by absolute rate unless told otherwise. Rates are percent per funding settlement (0.01 = 1 basis point); apr_pct is the annualised carry net of costs. Each row carries the settlement interval, the next settlement time, 7d and 30d sums and 24h volume. Filter by coin, venue, signed or absolute rate bounds, APR, interval, contract type, volume or time to the next settlement; for one coin's cross-venue picture prefer arbitron_get_coin_funding.

tools.name: arbitron_get_coin_funding
tools.title: One coin's funding across venues
tools.description: Every venue quoting a perpetual on one coin, the spread between the highest and lowest funding rate, which venue currently pays a short best (highest rate) and which pays a long best (lowest rate), and the venues that only quote an inverse contract. Rates are percent per funding settlement (0.01 = 1 basis point); apr_pct is the annualised carry net of costs. strategy_url opens a funding strategy on that pair in the Arbitron terminal, short the best short venue and long the best long one, in Hold Mode, with the form filled in; it creates nothing until the trader presses Start there. Narrow the ranking to a venue list or a volume floor. Unknown tickers return suggestions.

tools.name: arbitron_get_funding_history
tools.title: Funding history
tools.description: Funding history for one coin. resolution "1d" (default) returns one annualised APR point in percent per day for each venue quoting the coin, up to 180 days; resolution "settlement" returns every settlement print (rate_pct per settlement) for one venue, up to 92 days per call and needs exactly one exchange. order=desc with a limit reads the last N points. How far back the account may reach depends on its plan; the error says so.

tools.name: arbitron_get_spreads
tools.title: Current cross-venue spreads
tools.description: The price spread between two venues' perpetuals on the same coin RIGHT NOW, from the engine's last print (seconds old): one row per venue pair and symbol, best spread first. spread_pct is the better of the two entry directions in percent of price and direction names it (long_a_short_b = buy on exchange_a, sell on exchange_b); both directions, the bid and ask on each leg, 24h volumes, the funding rates with their intervals and strength (0 to 5) are included. Filter by coin, venues (either or both legs), spread bounds, direction, volume on both legs, strength or print age. For how often a spread paid over a window use arbitron_get_spread_backtest. Demo accounts get the print 15 minutes late, without the five widest spreads of any venue (meta.withheld says how many the snapshot holds back), and at most 100 rows deep.

tools.name: arbitron_get_spread_backtest
tools.title: Backtested cross-venue spreads
tools.description: Backtested spreads from the public scanner: for each venue pair and symbol, how the spread behaved over the scan window when priced against real order-book depth for an order of size_usd. est_profit_pct is the estimated profit per round trip after fees (percent), cycles counts how often the spread opened and closed, confidence is 0 to 100, and strategy_url opens a new strategy on that pair in the Arbitron terminal with the coin and both venues filled in (the trader sets the thresholds and size there). Filter by coin, venues, profit bounds, cycles, confidence, volume on both legs or how recently the last cycle closed. A backtest, not the live print: use arbitron_get_spreads for the spread right now. Demo accounts never see the five best rows of any venue, whatever the filter (withheld_top says how many the snapshot holds back), and read at most 100 rows deep.

tools.name: arbitron_get_listings
tools.title: Listings and delistings
tools.description: Announced perpetual listings and delistings across venues: venue, symbol, coin, kind (listing or delisting), status, when it takes effect, how it was detected and the announcement URL. Defaults to what takes effect in the next 14 days, nearest first. Filter by coin, venue, kind, status, source, or what was first seen in the last N hours.

tools.name: arbitron_get_exchanges
tools.title: Venues
tools.description: The venues Arbitron serves, with the number of tracked instruments, maximum leverage, default taker fee in percent, whether spot exists, and links to each venue's contract specs and funding pages. The exchange field is the spelling the other tools accept.

tools.name: arbitron_get_usage
tools.title: Plan and usage
tools.description: The plan behind this credential and its usage: calls used and remaining in the month and in the current minute, when each window resets, history reach in days, data delay in seconds and whether commercial use is included. Explains a rate limit or quota error.

tools.name: arbitron_get_my_account
tools.title: My account overview
tools.description: The signed-in trader's account at a glance: plan and its expiry, trading cards by status, today's net PnL with fees, funding, volume and completed cycles since the account's local midnight, total equity across connected exchange accounts, and which exchanges are connected. Money is in USD; net figures include fee rebates; times are UTC. A good first call before the more detailed account tools.

tools.name: arbitron_get_my_cards
tools.title: My trading cards
tools.description: The trader's trading cards: coin, the two exchanges and accounts, mode (classic two-leg spread or one-leg), status (running = trading, open = connected but not trading, error = needs attention, closed = dormant), the open and close spread thresholds in percent, order size, filled orders out of the maximum, leverage, net PnL over the card's life, this session and today, the last fill time and the error reason if any. Money is in USD; net figures include fee rebates; times are UTC. Each card carries a card_ref for arbitron_get_my_card and arbitron_get_my_trades.

tools.name: arbitron_get_my_card
tools.title: One of my trading cards in detail
tools.description: One trading card in full: its settings, the risk limits (force stop, exit on loss, liquidation protection, order pricing per leg), the current session's fees, funding, volume, cycles and fee share of gross, the open position on each leg with entry, unrealized PnL and liquidation price, and its 20 most recent paired trades from the last 31 days. Money is in USD; net figures include fee rebates; times are UTC.

tools.name: arbitron_get_my_trades
tools.title: My trade history
tools.description: The trader's executed trades over a window of up to 31 days, grouped by card: per card the net PnL, profit percent on capital, fees, funding and fills, and the most recent paired trades (both legs with exchange, side, price, quantity, notional and fee, the venue's order id, and any unwind). Totals for the window come first and cover every trade; at most 300 pairs are listed in one answer (pairs_truncated says when more exist). Money is in USD; net figures include fee rebates; times are UTC. For daily or monthly totals over longer periods use arbitron_get_my_pnl.

tools.name: arbitron_get_my_pnl
tools.title: My PnL calendar
tools.description: Realized PnL by day for one month, or by month for one year, in the account's own time zone, with fills and volume per period and the total. Days and months without trading are left out. Money is in USD; net figures include fee rebates; times are UTC.

tools.name: arbitron_get_my_balances
tools.title: My balances and positions
tools.description: Balances on every connected exchange account: equity (wallet plus unrealized PnL), unrealized PnL, the maintenance margin as a percent of equity where the venue reports it (100 = liquidation), each currency worth at least 1 USD with total, available and USD value (smaller balances are summed into dust_usd), and every open position with side, size, entry, mark, unrealized PnL, leverage and liquidation price. Each account says when its figures were last reported. Money is in USD; net figures include fee rebates; times are UTC.

tools.name: arbitron_get_my_balance_history
tools.title: My balance history
tools.description: How each exchange account's equity moved over the last days: start and end equity, the change, the closing equity of each UTC day, and the deposits, withdrawals, transfers, liquidations and bonuses recorded in the window (newest 100). Money is in USD; net figures include fee rebates; times are UTC.

tools.name: arbitron_get_my_exchange_accounts
tools.title: My connected exchange accounts
tools.description: The exchange accounts connected to Arbitron: exchange, the label given to the account, whether it is active and the default for its exchange, the taker fee in percent, default leverage, order pricing and minimum position lifetime. API keys and secrets are never included.

tools.name: arbitron_get_my_leaderboard
tools.title: My place on the leaderboard
tools.description: The trader's rank on the Arbitron leaderboard for a period and the top 10 traders, with net PnL of finished round trips, profit percent, win rate in percent of closed cycles, fills and the streak of profitable weeks. Other traders appear by rank, never by name, and those who hide their PnL stay hidden. Money is in USD; net figures include fee rebates; times are UTC.

tools.name: arbitron_get_my_subscription
tools.title: My plan and payments
tools.description: The account's Arbitron plan (Free, Preview, Scanner, Trader, Insider or Prime), its status, expiry and days remaining, and the last 20 payments with status, kind, price in USD, the amount paid, the currency and any discount.

tools.name: arbitron_search_docs
tools.title: Search the Arbitron knowledge base
tools.description: Searches the Arbitron knowledge base (how spread and one-leg arbitrage work on Arbitron, trading cards and every setting, spreads and signals, funding, risk and PnL, exchange connection, the server, plans) and returns the best-matching sections with a snippet, the article slug and its page. Read the whole article with arbitron_read_doc. With no query it lists every article.

tools.name: arbitron_read_doc
tools.title: Read a knowledge-base article
tools.description: One Arbitron knowledge-base article in full, as Markdown with absolute links: the title, the summary and every section, with settings tables, steps and formulas written out.
